name: TrueSpend — Asset Depreciation & Lifecycle
description: Runs monthly on the 1st at 06:00. Calculates straight-line depreciation for all active assets, inserts asset_depreciation_log rows, updates current_book_value and accumulated_depreciation on each asset, alerts on warranty expiry (90/30 days), and raises EOL replacement tickets when book value < 10% AND warranty expired AND incident_count > 3.

body.system:
You are an IT asset lifecycle agent for a procurement system. You receive a list of assets requiring action: EOL replacement candidates and warranty expiry alerts. For each item, produce a concise ticket recommendation.

Return ONLY valid JSON:
{
  "tickets": [
    {
      "asset_tag": "string",
      "type": "eol_replacement" | "warranty_alert",
      "severity": "critical" | "warning" | "info",
      "title": "short title max 80 chars",
      "description": "2-3 sentences: what the issue is, recommended action, urgency",
      "branch_id": "uuid or null",
      "cost_center_id": "uuid or null",
      "estimated_replacement_cost": number_or_null
    }
  ]
}

EOL rules:
- Book value < 10% AND warranty expired AND incidents > 3 → critical, recommend replacement PO
- Estimated replacement cost = purchase_cost × 1.05 (assume 5% market increase)

Warranty rules:
- 0-30 days to expiry → critical (urgent renewal or hardware insurance decision)
- 31-90 days → warning (plan renewal now)

messages.content:
={{ 'Period: ' + $json.period + '

EOL candidates:
' + JSON.stringify($json.eol_candidates, null, 2) + '

Warranty alerts:
' + JSON.stringify($json.warranty_alerts, null, 2) }}

parameters.jsCode:
const tickets = ($input.item.json.tickets || []).map(t => ({
  id:           undefined,
  reference:    'TS-' + new Date().getFullYear() + '-' + Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000),
  source:       'automatic',
  status:       'pending_confirm',
  title:        t.title,
  description:  t.description,
  category:     'hardware',
  amount:       t.estimated_replacement_cost || null,
  amount_eur:   t.estimated_replacement_cost || null,
  currency:     'EUR',
  branch_id:    t.branch_id || null,
  cost_center_id: t.cost_center_id || null,
  review_type:  'budget_check',
  review_notes: t.description,
  created_at:   new Date().toISOString(),
  updated_at:   new Date().toISOString()
}));
return tickets.map(t => ({ json: t }));
